journeys.name: 01-focus-cycle
journeys.promise: The core promise: a focus block runs, the wedge drains, and completion hands off to a break automatically

journeys.name: 02-pause-resume
journeys.promise: Pause freezes the wedge exactly where it is; Resume continues from there

journeys.name: 03-slices-persist
journeys.promise: A completed focus block earns a slice that survives a full reload

journeys.name: 04-reset-no-credit
journeys.promise: Reset restores the full block — and never awards a slice for abandoned work

results.note: effect staged via API — a human performs this step in real use

results.step: the timer is ready with a full 25-minute block
it starts in Focus mode, not on a break
the main button invites her to Start
the block is running — the button now offers Pause
when the block ends it moves her to a break by itself
the break starts fresh, at its full length
while paused, the clock does not lose a second
the button now offers to Resume
it carries on from where it stopped, not from the top
she has earned nothing yet, and the app says so
finishing the block earns her a slice
the slice she earned is still there
and the app no longer says she has nothing
the timer goes back to a full, untouched block
the button offers Start again, as if nothing had run
and crucially she earns NO slice for the abandoned work
